input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Services clause expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms that the Agreement does not restrict AP from offering or selling Inventory through other agents or third parties, which matches our preferred position of no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on the Customer. A full-text review found no "sole provider", requirements-purchase, non-compete or "shall not procure from any third party" language binding AP; the remaining uses of "exclusive" relate to the non-exclusive license granted to us, exclusive jurisdiction, each Party's own trademark ownership, and third-party beneficiary limits, none of which restrict our freedom to buy from other suppliers. No redline required.
